title: Spartacus Dreams

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Hey! Was kinda hoping I'd run into you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey! Was kinda hoping I'd run into you.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Oh, hey.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, hey.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: You know, jabs, gouges, piledrivers. Shark grips, claw splinters. The usual.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, jabs, gouges, piledrivers. Shark grips, claw splinters. The usual.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Guess I just like talking to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guess I just like talking to you.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I know. Just can’t get my mind into the now. Keep thinking back, not forwards.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. Just can’t get my mind into the now. Keep thinking back, not forwards.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Ha. You sound like one of those bots.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha. You sound like one of those bots.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Got me thinking again about the bakery. I had it all worked out. Plan was to get promoted from patissier to head baker. Then open my own pastry shop.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Got me thinking again about the bakery. I had it all worked out. Plan was to get promoted from patissier to head baker. Then open my own pastry shop.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Doom & Bloom. We'd sell flowers on the side.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doom & Bloom. We'd sell flowers on the side.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Yeah, I know. I was just remembering the bakery. I had it all worked out, back then. Get promoted from patissier to head baker. Then open my own pastry shop.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I know. I was just remembering the bakery. I had it all worked out, back then. Get promoted from patissier to head baker. Then open my own pastry shop.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: You think so? Well, it was a nice dream.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think so? Well, it was a nice dream.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Nah. If I don't fight Obliterata Four, my mods will be forfeit. But if I do fight her, I don't think I'll come out the other side.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nah. If I don't fight Obliterata Four, my mods will be forfeit. But if I do fight her, I don't think I'll come out the other side.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I wasn't asking you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wasn't asking you.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Yeah, I was stupid to think... whatever. I gotta go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I was stupid to think... whatever. I gotta go.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I can't call anything. That's down to Floyd.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't call anything. That's down to Floyd.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Win... yeah. Guess it's the only way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Win... yeah. Guess it's the only way.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: So? I'm still contracted to the gym. Doesn't matter if I win or bite the dust, he gets paid. And he isn't about to start losing Lims over me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So? I'm still contracted to the gym. Doesn't matter if I win or bite the dust, he gets paid. And he isn't about to start losing Lims over me.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Won't do any good. But all the same... thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Won't do any good. But all the same... thanks.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Like I told you. Anyway, I'd say see you around but... well. Maybe I won't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like I told you. Anyway, I'd say see you around but... well. Maybe I won't.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How come?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How come?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How's training?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's training?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like talking to you, too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like talking to you, too.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I like talking to you, too.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I like talking to you, too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You’ll never win with that attitude!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’ll never win with that attitude!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You’ll never win with that attitude!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You’ll never win with that attitude!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yesterday is just another rung on the ladder to tomorrow!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yesterday is just another rung on the ladder to tomorrow!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yesterday is just another rung on the ladder to tomorrow!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yesterday is just another rung on the ladder to tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What were you going to call it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What were you going to call it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What were you going to call it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What were you going to call it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Doesn't sound like a viable business model to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn't sound like a viable business model to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Doesn't sound like a viable business model to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Doesn't sound like a viable business model to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds great.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds great.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just trying to help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just trying to help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could still make it happen.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could still make it happen.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You could still make it happen.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You could still make it happen.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just being honest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just being honest.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry. Maybe you could give it a go anyway?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry. Maybe you could give it a go anyway?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry. Maybe you could give it a go anyway?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry. Maybe you could give it a go anyway?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So go fight her and win!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So go fight her and win!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So go fight her and win!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So go fight her and win!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could call off the match...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could call off the match...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You could call off the match...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You could call off the match...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But he dropped you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But he dropped you!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll talk to him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Guess you're stuck then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guess you're stuck then.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A little motivation never hurts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A little motivation never hurts.
